selection_coverage.verifier_contract: Input route is implemented in source; runtime observation remains required.
selection_coverage.closure: Static implementation review only; no native or assembled-artifact certification.

frontpanel_coverage.closure: Source sequences and static integration only; no media freshness, assembly or native/pixel proof.

structural_coverage.meaning: Every occurrence inventoried and traced; compatibility gaps remain explicit.

compatibility_limitations: queue.2pitem: Non-prop held drops and full source two-player semantics require separate native coverage.
queue.alias: Generated alias table and opponent-target lifecycle still need assembled/current native runtime proof.
queue.coords: Source coordinate fractions, offscreen depth and independent enemy-drop drivers are not preserved by the ten-byte queue.
queue.health: Authored absolute/native HP and damage semantics are not proven by the compatibility HUD byte.
queue.item: Enemy-held drops are not represented by this obstacle-only compatibility encoder.
queue.map: Palette selector transport alone does not prove correct visible CGRAM.
queue.spawn: Roster identity is not native AI/action implementation; legacy borrowed-slot cases remain explicit below.
scene.animation: Scaled/quantized scene encoding is an adaptation; playback, skip cleanup and exactly-once completion are NOT_RUN.
native_coverage.pending_scope: Unsupported required source uses and explicitly pending native frontpanel acceptance; static implementation never clears native acceptance.

nonclaims: Definition presence is not executable reachability or native implementation proof.
No assembled ROM, generated media freshness, combat, visual, audio, or completion proof.
Queue bytes and model identity are compatibility transport, not source actor semantics.
